ceu: ✦ The square between Venus and Pluto

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: A day to step out of your mental routine. Try a different path, even a small one.
The square between Venus and Pluto creates some tension between money and friendships. A short pause avoids a long argument.
s.d: Talk with someone from another generation or another culture.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: The Moon passes through your deepest area. Emotions arrive with intensity, and with them the wish for truth.
The square between Venus and Pluto creates some tension between your image and your career. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
s.d: Throw away something you keep only out of attachment.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: Today relationships need attention: a partner, an associate or a close friend needs to feel your presence.
The square between Venus and Pluto creates some tension between your inner life and your horizons. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
s.d: Own up to a mistake of yours in a relationship, without beating about the bush.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: With the Moon in your house of daily work, practical tasks go well. Start with the one you keep putting off.
The square between Venus and Pluto creates some tension between friendships and intimacy. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
s.d: Drink a glass of water as soon as you wake up.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: The Moon lights up love, children and the inner child we all have. Laugh more and worry less.
The square between Venus and Pluto creates some tension between your career and relationships. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
s.d: Play with a child or remember what it was like to play.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: The Moon asks you for a safe harbour. If the day is hectic outside, create calm in your own space.
The square between Venus and Pluto creates some tension between your horizons and routine. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
s.d: Have dinner without the television and talk with the people you live with.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: The Moon passes through your area of conversations: messages, calls and quick meetings set the pace of the day.
The square between Venus and Pluto creates some tension between intimacy and romance. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
s.d: Ask the question you are embarrassed to ask: the answer may surprise you.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: Today the Moon asks for stability: whatever gives you security, be it money, home or affection, carries more weight.
The square between Venus and Pluto creates some tension between relationships and family. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
s.d: Before buying, wait twenty-four hours and see if you still want it.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: The Moon in your sign asks you to put yourself at the centre of the day. It is not selfishness: it is recharging so you can give more to others.
The square between Venus and Pluto creates some tension between routine and conversations. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
s.d: Write down three of your qualities and read them out loud.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: The Moon asks you to close cycles calmly before starting new ones. Tidy up on the inside.
The square between Venus and Pluto creates some tension between romance and money. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
s.d: Light some incense or a candle and breathe deeply.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: A day to feel part of something bigger. Call someone you have not spoken to in a while.
The square between Venus and Pluto creates some tension between family and your image. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
s.d: Send a message to a friend you miss.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: The Moon passes through your area of career and puts your goals in plain sight. Show what you are capable of.
The square between Venus and Pluto creates some tension between conversations and your inner life. Hear both sides before you decide.
s.d: Update your CV or your professional profile.
